About Hofkoh Saigon Two visitors from Germany Written by Matthias in Saigon What a surprize to have two sisters from Germany visiting our Vietnamese congregation. Travelling and working all around the world they stopped in Vietnam on their journey to Singapore, China, Korea and Japan. Good that some sisters of our congregation invited them to dinner after the meeting. At 22:00 the restaurant closed and the other brothers and sisters went home. So I had the chance to continue the conversation in my mother tongue for 3 more hours.
